API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIIntermediate CA CertificatesIntermediate Cert Resource Verify Key Attestation
Intermediate Cert Resource Verify Key Attestation
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/intermediateCaCertificate/verifyKeyAttestation/:certId

Verifies the attestation for the HSM keys generated for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
certId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the intermediate CA certificate.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
certId
int32

Unique identifier for the intermediate CA certificate

hsmAttestationVerifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the attestation for the HSM key was verified
